settings.effects_tip: Low: debris appears where it lands instead of falling, explosions are smaller and give no light. For slow graphics cards.
settings.remembered_buildings_tip: Buildings (also neutral ones) you have seen and lost sight of stay on the map. On: drawn with their models as last seen. Off: only their icons.
settings.sky_tip: The map's sky, the haze towards the horizon (tinted by the sky) and a layer of clouds that only shows when the camera is far up. Switch off for a plain background.
settings.terrain_detail_tip: Bare rock on steep slopes, broader colour variation and wet ground along the shore.
settings.preset_tip: Sets shadows, trees and rocks, effects, terrain, sky, buildings, grass and water together. Changing one of them shows Custom.
settings.vram_cap: This graphics card has {} MB of video memory, too little for the Ultra options (it ran out of memory and crashed): they are limited to High. Set LR_NOVRAMCAP=1 to lift the limit.
settings.distance_blur_tip: Blurs what lies far beyond the point the camera looks at (depth of field). 0 = off. Costs a little frame rate; not on very old graphics cards.
settings.distance_blur_gl: Not available with the OpenGL renderer: its shader compiler cannot build the depth-of-field effect. Use Vulkan or DirectX 12 for it.
settings.building_detail_tip: High: the map's theme (wall and roof paints and which house models it uses), every building differs in colour and wear, sharper textures with mipmaps, and destroyed buildings leave broken, burnt-out ruins with holes instead of a sunk wreck. Ultra: houses also get overhanging eaves and window sills, and windows and bare metal reflect the sky.
settings.grass_detail_tip: Tufts of grass on grassy ground near the camera. High: normal density. Ultra: denser and further out, with bending blades and wildflowers. Costs frame rate on weak graphics cards.
settings.water_detail_tip: Every level: a smooth shoreline with foam lapping along it. High: moving waves and sun glints. Ultra: real reflections of the land, units and sky (renders the scene a second time).
settings.neutral_buildings_tip: Strategic icons of neutral map buildings (houses, civic and industrial buildings). Off: only their models, at any zoom. A building someone garrisons shows that player's icon.
settings.auto_garrison_tip: Idle infantry walk into an empty or own garrisonable building close by.
settings.replays_tip: Every game is recorded to the replays folder (next to settings.json). Watch them from the main menu: Replays.
settings.replays_on: Save a replay of every game
settings.storage_gap_tip: Energy storages built in a line or block (Shift-drag) stand one cell apart, since they explode violently.
settings.storage_gap_on: Space out energy storages built with Shift
settings.ui_scale_tip: Size of menus, panels and text. 1x is the size the system asks for.
settings.units_under_icons_tip: Where a unit shows as its strategic icon (zoomed out, or too small to make out), its model is not drawn. Faster with big armies. Off: models stay under the icons.
settings.restart_needed: The graphics API changes after a restart.
settings.graphics_errors: {} graphics error(s) so far - details in render-errors.log. First one:
settings.black_view_hint: If the 3D view is black or broken, try another graphics API above.

hud_help.title: CONTROLS
hud_help.left_click_drag_select_box_select: Left click / drag: select, box select.  Double-click: all of that type on screen.  Shift: add.
hud_help.right_click_move_attack_enemy_assist: Right click: move / attack enemy / assist or repair friend / reclaim wreck (engineers alone: also trees and rocks).  Shift: queue.
hud_help.right_drag_a_line_spread_the: Right-drag a line: spread the selected units along it (Alt: attack-move).
hud_help.pings_and_drawing: Nothing selected: right double-click pings the map (also on the minimap), right-drag draws on it - your team sees both in your colour.
hud_help.faf_alternative_keys_w_move_alt: FAF alternative keys:  W move   Alt+W patrol   R attack / ground fire (drag = area)   Q reclaim (drag = area)
hud_help.a_attack_move_p_patrol_s: A attack-move    P patrol    S stop    G ground fire (drag = area)    E reclaim (drag = area)
hud_help.i_t_assist_repair_esc_stop: I / T assist, repair   Esc stop   O upgrade   ` factory repeat   F10 menu   Alt+right-click attack-move
hud_help.u_upgrade_pumps_factories_r_factory: U upgrade (pumps, factories)    R factory repeat    . idle builder    , commander
hud_help.hotbuild_press_again_to_cycle_z: Hotbuild (press again to cycle): Z builders/factories  X mass  C power  V radar/scouts  G direct fire
hud_help.hotkey_preset_can_be_switched_to: Hotkey preset can be switched to FAF alternative in the Esc menu.
hud_help.s_artillery_d_anti_air_y: S artillery  D anti-air  Y missiles  M engineering station
hud_help.ctrl_k_self_destruct_shift_0: Ctrl+K self-destruct.  Shift+0-9 adds a group to the selection.
hud_help.select_ctrl_a_air_ctrl_d: Select: Ctrl+A air  Ctrl+D land army  Ctrl+B engineers  Ctrl+X all  Ctrl+C all on screen  Ctrl+Z same type  Ctrl+H factories
hud_help.ctrl_shift_d_a_nearest_land: Ctrl+Shift+D / A nearest land / air factory   . next idle builder   , commander   Ctrl+K self-destruct
hud_help.ctrl_r_distribute: Ctrl+R share the selection's queued orders out among it   / nearest extractor of the lowest tier (Shift+/ adds the next)
hud_help.build_menu_click_then_click_the: Build menu: click, then click the map; drag for a row of buildings; sandbags and trenches: draw any line with the right button; pumps: drag a circle.
hud_help.factory_menu_left_click_queues: Factory menu: left-click queues (Shift x5), right-click removes.
hud_help.ctrl_0_9_set_group_0: Ctrl+0-9 set group, 0-9 recall (double tap: centre).  Selection panel: click a type to keep only it.
hud_help.tab_pauses_resumes_the_selection: Tab pauses / resumes the selection: builders and factories stop, pumps and radars switch off (no upkeep).
hud_help.wheel_zoom_arrows_or_middle_drag: Wheel zoom, arrows, screen edges or middle-drag pan, minimap click.  F6 shadows on/off.  F11 fullscreen.  Pause / Ctrl+P pauses the game.
hud_help.radar_is_blocked_by_hills_seen: Radar is blocked by hills.  Seen buildings stay marked until you look again.
hud_help.l_load_board_a_transport_k: L load / board a transport   K unload (drag = area)   J revive wrecks (scavengers, drag = area)
hud_help.reclaim_click_a_wreck_tree_rock: Reclaim: click a wreck, tree, rock or building, drag = every wreck, tree and rock in the circle.  Terraform button: drag a circle, wheel = raise / lower.
hud_help.a_box_selects_the_army_engineers: A box selects the army; engineers and the commander only when no fighting unit is inside (or use Ctrl+B / ,).

commander.name: Commander
commander.desc: Command mech. Builds the base. Lose it and you lose the battle.

engineer.name: Engineer
engineer.desc: Builds tier 1 structures, assists, repairs and reclaims.

scavenger.name: Scavenger
scavenger.desc: Cannot build. Reclaims wrecks, debris, trees and rocks, or revives wrecks as working units for your side (right-click a wreck, or J and drag a circle).

apc.name: Tavria
apc.desc: Light armoured carrier. Fast and cheap: takes four land units under thin armour (L load, K unload), proof against rifles and machine guns but not much more. Unarmed.

apc_amph.name: Slavuta
apc_amph.desc: Amphibious armoured carrier. The Tavria's light hull made watertight: takes six land units (L load, K unload) and drives along the bottom of rivers and lakes up to 4 deep, out of reach of guns, slower there. Unarmed.

apc_heavy.name: Zaporozhets
apc_heavy.desc: Infantry fighting vehicle, heavily armoured. Takes eight land units under thick armour (L load, K unload): shrugs off small arms, riot guns and much of an autocannon's fire, and takes several tank shells. A roof machine gun keeps infantry off it. Slow.

apc_heavy3.name: Hetman
apc_heavy3.desc: Heavy infantry fighting vehicle, the Zaporozhets grown up. Takes ten land units under thick armour (L load, K unload), with explosive reactive armor on top: its first four missile hits (AT troopers, Robins) lose three quarters of their damage, and a full repair replaces the tiles. Twin roof machine guns.

buggy.name: Buggy
buggy.desc: Land scout. Fast, fragile, long sight - the eyes of your guns.

trooper.name: Trooper
trooper.desc: Armored assault bot. Cheap plasma gun that also hurts armor.

at_trooper.name: AT Trooper
at_trooper.desc: Infantry with a guided anti-tank missile and six rounds of it; spent rounds come back one a minute for mass. Slow to reload; best fired from cover or from a building.

sniper_trooper.name: Sniper Trooper
sniper_trooper.desc: Marksman with a long rifle. Slow, accurate shots; also picks off infantry inside buildings from afar without harming the building.

sam_trooper.name: SAM Trooper
sam_trooper.desc: Infantry with a shoulder-fired homing anti-air missile and six rounds of it; spent rounds come back one a minute for mass. Aircraft only.

overtaker.name: Overtaker M1
overtaker.desc: Light tank. Quick flanker with a 75 mm gauss cannon.

pike.name: Pike Mortar
pike.desc: Mobile mortar. High-arc fire over hills, range 25-100. Slow traverse. Fires only standing and stays put 3 s after each shot.

mbfag.name: MBFAG-113
mbfag.desc: Mobile anti-air system. Rotary cannon bursts, long reach against aircraft.

flak_carrier.name: Hailstorm
flak_carrier.desc: Mobile flak on the Dragoon chassis. Bursts of airburst shells out to 100 at aircraft, ground units and infantry. Fast-slewing guns.

mobile_sam.name: Skylance
mobile_sam.desc: Mobile SAM on the Robin chassis. Its own T2 search radar (needs energy; finds stealth 1 aircraft) guides a heavy homing missile at aircraft out to 130, then it reloads for 10 s.

radar_car.name: UC-01R Radar
radar_car.desc: Mobile T1 radar: finds unstealthed units within 120. Hills block it. Needs energy.

radar_car2.name: UC-02R Radar
radar_car2.desc: Mobile T2 radar: finds unstealthed units within 180 and stealth 1 units (T2 aircraft) within 110. Hills block it. Costly to run.

radar_car3.name: UC-03R Radar
radar_car3.desc: Mobile T3 radar: finds unstealthed units within 260, stealth 1 units within 180 and stealth 2 units (T3 aircraft) within 100. Infantry never show on radar. Hills block it. Very costly to run.

crony.name: Crony M1
crony.desc: Main battle tank. Slow turret, heavy armor, 200 damage at range 80.

dragoon.name: Dragoon ARV
dragoon.desc: Armored recon vehicle. Very fast, long sight, 7-round autocannon bursts.

robin.name: Robin
robin.desc: Mobile anti-tank. One guided missile every 30 seconds; it kills most tanks.

engineer2.name: Engineer Mk2
engineer2.desc: Combat engineer. Builds tier 1-2 structures and field fortifications: sandbags, trenches, bunkers and watch towers. Carries a riot gun and a short-range radar.

bohdana.name: Bohdana
bohdana.desc: Self-propelled howitzer. Range 60-300. Slow to aim, useless without spotters. Fires only standing and stays put 5 s after each shot.

bastion.name: Bastion
bastion.desc: Heavy tank with explosive reactive armor: its first four missile hits (AT troopers, Robins) lose three quarters of their damage, and a full repair replaces the tiles. 220 damage at range 85, slow turret.

engineer3.name: Engineer Mk3
engineer3.desc: Heavy combat engineer. Builds every structure and fortification. Armed like the Mk2, with twice the armor.

air_scout.name: Kestrel
air_scout.desc: Air scout. Huge sight radius, unarmed.

interceptor.name: Porter
interceptor.desc: Interceptor. Fixed forward railguns, air targets only.

interceptor3.name: Cyclone
interceptor3.desc: Heavy air superiority fighter. Railguns for aircraft only. Stealth 2, and its own T3 fire-control radar finds stealthed aircraft within 80 (needs energy).

bomber.name: Firebrand
bomber.desc: Attack bomber. Runs over its target, drops a stick of five bombs across it, flies on and comes round for the next pass.

fighter_bomber.name: Harrier FB
fighter_bomber.desc: Fighter-bomber. Fast; railguns for aircraft and a pair of bombs for ground targets.

gunship.name: Hornet
gunship.desc: Gunship. Hovers and rakes ground units with riot gun bursts, infantry first.

dove.name: Dove
dove.desc: Suicide drone. Cheap, slow and fragile: any anti-air swats it down. Flies at its target and dives into it with a heavy mortar round.

air_transport.name: Stork
air_transport.desc: Transport aircraft. Lifts eight land units over cliffs and water (L load, K unload). Unarmed.

fast_transport.name: Swift
fast_transport.desc: Fast transport plane for airdrops: twice as fast as the Stork and never stops. Unload (K) over a spot or a dragged circle: it flies straight through and the cargo falls spread over it, landing 2-3 s later (a dragged circle also sends infantry into free buildings). Carries eight land units like the Stork (L load: it scoops up units it flies over). Stealth 1: only T2+ radar finds it. Unarmed.

delivery_boy.name: Delivery Boy
delivery_boy.desc: Prototype heavy bomber. One enormous bomb, armored airframe.

pump.name: Mass Pump
pump.desc: Extracts mass from a deposit. Upgradeable (U).

pump2.name: Mass Pump Mk2
pump2.desc: Triple output, more upkeep. Built by tier 2+ engineers or upgraded from a Mass Pump (U).

pump3.name: Mass Pump Mk3
pump3.desc: Maximum extraction, heavy energy upkeep. Built by tier 3 engineers or upgraded from a Mk2 pump.

power_plant.name: Power Plant
power_plant.desc: Reliable power: +120 energy. Explodes when destroyed.

land_factory.name: Land Factory
land_factory.desc: Builds tier 1 land units. Upgrade (U) for higher tiers.

land_factory2.name: Land Factory Mk2
land_factory2.desc: Builds tier 1-2 land units. Right-click sets the rally point.

land_factory3.name: Land Factory Mk3
land_factory3.desc: Builds tier 1-3 land units. Right-click sets the rally point.

air_factory.name: Air Factory
air_factory.desc: Builds tier 1 air units. Upgrade (U) for higher tiers.

air_factory2.name: Air Factory Mk2
air_factory2.desc: Builds tier 1-2 air units. Right-click sets the rally point.

air_factory3.name: Air Factory Mk3
air_factory3.desc: Builds tier 1-3 air units. Right-click sets the rally point.

hmg_turret.name: HMG Turret
hmg_turret.desc: Point defense. Shreds bots and scouts, bounces off armor.

gauss_turret.name: Pike-G Gauss Turret
gauss_turret.desc: Anti-armor emplacement. High-arc fire, range 30-105, very slow traverse.

sam.name: Faust SAM
sam.desc: Long-range SAM site. Its own T2 search radar (needs energy; finds stealth 1 aircraft) guides one heavy homing missile at an aircraft, then it reloads for 12 s.

aa_turret3.name: Phalanx Railgun Battery
aa_turret3.desc: Heavy anti-air battery: twin long railguns guided by its own T3 radar (finds stealth 2 aircraft within 120; needs energy).

radar_tower.name: Radar Tower
radar_tower.desc: T1 radar: finds unstealthed units within 160. Blocked by terrain - build it on high ground. Needs energy. Upgradeable (U).

radar_tower2.name: Radar Tower Mk2
radar_tower2.desc: T2 radar: finds unstealthed units within 250 and stealth 1 units (T2 aircraft) within 160. Blocked by terrain. Costly to run. Built by tier 2+ engineers or upgraded from a Radar Tower (U).

radar_tower3.name: Radar Tower Mk3
radar_tower3.desc: T3 radar: finds unstealthed units within 360, stealth 1 units within 250 and stealth 2 units (T3 aircraft) within 150. Infantry never show on radar. Blocked by terrain. Very costly to run. Built by tier 3 engineers or upgraded from a Radar Tower Mk2 (U).

eng_station.name: Engineering Station
eng_station.desc: Automatically assists every construction, upgrade and repair within its radius.

heavy_battery.name: Bertha Heavy Battery
heavy_battery.desc: Fortified 120 mm gun. Range 40-200, big blast, traverses at a crawl.

sandbags.name: Sandbags
sandbags.desc: A stretch of sandbag wall; draw a line of any shape with the right mouse button (or drag a straight one) to build it. Shots from any side that fly through it lose half their damage to it, until it is shot or bombed to pieces. Infantry of every side take cover behind it. Units can cross it.

trench.name: Trench
trench.desc: A piece of trench; draw a line of any shape with the right mouse button (or drag a straight one) to build it. The ground is dug out and stays dug when the trench is destroyed. Infantry standing in it lose only part of every hit and blast to it - the rest goes into the trench, which gives way in time.

field_bunker.name: Field Bunker
field_bunker.desc: Concrete bunker for up to 4 infantry, who fire from it and take only a small share of the hits on it.

watch_tower.name: Watch Tower
watch_tower.desc: Tall lookout for up to 2 infantry: from its platform they see and use their binoculars 1.6 times as far, over trees and low hills, and fire from up there.

warehouse.name: Warehouse
warehouse.desc: Industrial storage. Leaves plenty of scrap.

refinery.name: Refinery
refinery.desc: Industrial plant. Burns fiercely when destroyed.

fuel_tank.name: Fuel Tank
fuel_tank.desc: Industrial. Explodes when hit hard enough.

containers.name: Container Stack 1
containers.desc: Industrial building. Leaves scrap to reclaim.

containers2.name: Container Stack 2
containers2.desc: Industrial building. Leaves scrap to reclaim.

farm.name: Agricultural Center
farm.desc: Industrial building. Leaves scrap to reclaim.

plant.name: Manufacturing Plant
plant.desc: Industrial building. Leaves scrap to reclaim.

bunker.name: Bunker
bunker.desc: Fortified position. Hostile garrisons shoot at anything in range.

ai.simple_desc: the old AI: builds up at home and attacks in growing waves
ai.overseer_desc: changes its strategy with the situation: rush, eco and tech, air, turtle, commander kill (after M27)
ai.zones_desc: takes and holds the map zone by zone, scouts everything, helps allies (after M28)
ai.adaptive_desc: expands wide, raids extractors, builds what counters your army (after RNG)
ai.rusher_desc: many factories, cheap units, early and constant attacks
ai.turtle_desc: turrets, radar and long range guns; techs up and attacks late

preset_editor.fix_json_text: Fix the JSON in the text box first.
preset_editor.unit_copied: Copied. Give the copy its own id and icon (shape, glyphs or tier), then save.
preset_editor.unit_removed: Removed (not saved yet). Saving fails if something still refers to the unit.
preset_editor.title: GAME DATA PRESETS
preset_editor.intro: A preset is a named copy of the game data (unit stats, costs, rules) that you can change. The host picks one in the lobby; the other players receive it when the game starts. Hover over a setting to see what it does.
preset_editor.name_needed: Type a name first (letters, digits, spaces, - and _).
preset_editor.pick_preset: Pick a preset on the left, or create one.
preset_editor.check_and_save_tip: Checks the data the way the game loads it and writes the preset if it is sound.
preset_editor.form_view_tip: Edit with checkboxes, number fields and lists.
preset_editor.json_view_tip: Edit the raw JSON: every setting, including model files and turret bones.
preset_editor.not_json: This does not read as JSON; switch to the JSON view to fix it.

preset_rules.switch_terraforming_tip: Engineers and commanders can level, raise and lower the ground (the Terraform button). Off: the button is gone and terraform orders are ignored.
preset_rules.switch_craters_tip: Heavy hits and death blasts dig shell holes into the ground (their size is set under Craters and terraforming). Off: shelling never changes the ground.
preset_rules.switch_wrecks_tip: Destroyed units leave wrecks: they hold mass to reclaim, give cover against shots and block sight. Off: destroyed units leave nothing behind. A unit's own 'Leaves a wreck' setting still applies when this is on.
preset_rules.switch_sight_blocked_by_terrain_tip: A unit only sees what it has a clear line to over the terrain. Off: units see everything within their vision range, hills or not.
preset_rules.switch_sight_blocked_by_reclaimables: Trees, rocks and wrecks block sight
preset_rules.switch_sight_blocked_by_reclaimables_tip: Standing trees, rocks and wrecks block the view like small hills. Off: sight passes through them (they still soak up shots as cover).
preset_rules.switch_sight_blocked_by_buildings_tip: Finished buildings (yours, enemy and map buildings) block the view behind them up to their height. Infantry inside a building still look out from its roof, and a building never hides itself. Off: sight passes through buildings.
preset_rules.switch_radar_blocked_by_terrain_tip: Radar needs a clear line over the terrain, looking from 'Radar eye height' above the unit. Off: radar sees through hills.
preset_rules.switch_counter_battery_tip: Radar that has a mortar or howitzer shell in flight within its range finds the gun that fired it: the gun shows as a radar contact while its shells fly, so long guns can shoot back. Off: artillery stays hidden unless spotted.
preset_rules.switch_ghosts_show_destroyed_tip: An enemy building you have seen and then lost sight of stays on your map as you last saw it. When it is destroyed while nobody of your team looks, its model turns dim (as in SupCom), so you know it is gone without scouting. Off: it looks intact until you see the empty spot.
preset_rules.switch_ai_reclaim_tip: AI engineers reclaim nearby trees and rocks when they run short of mass or energy.
preset_rules.switch_friendly_fire_tip: Shots and blasts also hurt your own and allied units, not just enemies.
preset_rules.eco_start_mass_tip: Mass every player has at the start.
preset_rules.eco_start_energy_tip: Energy every player has at the start.
preset_rules.eco_reclaim_rate_tip: Mass reclaimed per second for every point of an engineer's build power.
preset_rules.eco_reclaim_energy_factor_tip: Reclaiming trees and rocks: energy comes this many times faster than mass.
preset_rules.eco_repair_rate_tip: Hit points repaired per second for every point of build power.
preset_rules.eco_power_stall_pump_factor: Pump output when out of energy
preset_rules.eco_power_stall_pump_factor_tip: When energy runs out, mass pumps produce at least this share of their output.
preset_rules.eco_capture_time_tip: Capturing a unit takes its build time times this, at the engineer's build power.
preset_rules.eco_capture_energy_tip: Share of the target's energy cost that capturing it uses up.
preset_rules.eco_infantry_capture_secs_tip: With the lobby option "Infantry capture buildings": seconds one infantryman takes to take a building over; several share the work. Costs no energy.
preset_rules.eco_infantry_capture_reach_tip: Infantry without a capture order take a capturable building by themselves when it is within this distance (idle, moving or attack-moving).
preset_rules.eco_infantry_capture_guard_tip: An armed enemy unit within this distance of a building stops infantry from capturing it.
preset_rules.combat_gravity_tip: Pulls every shell and bomb down (units per second squared). Higher: shorter, steeper arcs and less reach for artillery.
preset_rules.combat_commander_death_damage_tip: Damage of the explosion when a commander dies.
preset_rules.combat_commander_death_radius_tip: Radius of the explosion when a commander dies.
preset_rules.combat_armor_front_tip: Armored units (category armored) take this share of a hit head on. Between front, side and rear it blends with the angle; shells falling steeply count the angle less, one falling straight down not at all.
preset_rules.combat_armor_side_tip: Share of a hit an armored unit takes from the side.
preset_rules.combat_armor_rear_tip: Share of a hit an armored unit takes from behind.
preset_rules.combat_splash_direct_tip: Share of a gun shell's damage that units it did not hit take at the blast centre (fading to none at the edge). The unit hit directly always takes all of it. Weapons can set their own splash.
preset_rules.combat_splash_armored_tip: Armored units (category armored) take this share of any splash: blasts of shells that did not hit them directly, and death blasts.
preset_rules.intel_near_sight_tip: Everything closer than this to a unit is seen at once, whatever stands in between.
preset_rules.intel_spot_forget_tip: Units with a time to spot: how long out of the enemy's view until he has to start spotting them from nothing again.
preset_rules.intel_vision_los_height_tip: Units look from this high above their top; a higher eye sees over more hills and trees.
preset_rules.intel_radar_los_height_tip: Radar looks from this high above the unit's top (when hills block radar).
preset_rules.intel_radar_fade_secs_tip: How long the blip of a moving unit stays on the map after radar has lost it.
preset_rules.wrecks_wreck_mass_fraction_tip: A wreck holds this share of the unit's mass cost (a building taken apart gives the same).
preset_rules.wrecks_max_wrecks_tip: At most this many wrecks lie on the map at once; the oldest disappear first.
preset_rules.wrecks_wreck_hp_tip: A wreck's hit points as a share of the unit's. Shells and blasts wear wrecks down; the mass goes with the hit points.
preset_rules.wrecks_revive_cooldown_tip: Seconds before the wreck of a revived unit, or of a revival site destroyed unfinished, can be revived again.
preset_rules.wrecks_wreck_cover_tip: Share of a shot's damage a wreck soaks up when the shot passes through it.
preset_rules.wrecks_tree_fall_tip: Share of a tree's or rock's hit points one blast must do to throw the tree down or shatter the rock. A felled tree lies as a charred log, a shattered rock as rubble: they no longer block sight, give little cover and can still be reclaimed. 0: never.
preset_rules.cover_grace_tip: Trees, rocks and wrecks closer than this to the shooter give no cover from its shots (units fire out from behind their own cover).
preset_rules.cover_search_tip: Infantry look for cover within this distance of where they were sent.
preset_rules.cover_threat_range_tip: Infantry take cover from known armed enemies up to this far away.
preset_rules.cover_garrison_eject_damage_tip: Infantry thrown out of a destroyed building lose this share of their hit points.
preset_rules.cover_garrison_damage_tip: Infantry inside a building take this share of every hit on it (their own armor applies).
preset_rules.cover_garrison_vision_tip: Infantry inside a building look out from its roof: their vision and binocular range times this.
preset_rules.cover_garrison_defense_tip: Infantry holding a building deal this many times their close-quarters (assault) damage to infantry storming it.
preset_rules.terrain_crater_scale_tip: Crater depth = this x the square root of the damage. 0 = no craters.
preset_rules.terrain_crater_max_depth_tip: Shelling never digs deeper than this below the original ground.
preset_rules.terrain_crater_min_damage_tip: Hits weaker than this leave no mark on the ground.
preset_rules.terrain_terraform_rate_tip: Ground height moved per second for every point of build power.
preset_rules.terrain_terraform_energy_tip: Energy per unit of ground height moved.
preset_rules.terrain_terraform_max_tip: Terraforming stays within this height of the original ground.
preset_rules.points_cp_radius_tip: Control points mode: units within this distance of a point take it.
preset_rules.points_cp_capture_secs_tip: Seconds a team needs to take a control point.
preset_rules.points_cp_start_points_tip: Points every team starts with (the host can pick another number in the lobby). A team at 0 is defeated.
preset_rules.points_cp_bleed_tip: A team holding fewer control points than its strongest opponent loses this many points per second for each point of difference.
preset_rules.feature_id_tip: Name maps use for this type. Changing it breaks maps that place it.
preset_rules.feature_class_tip: Where the map generator puts it: trees in woods, rocks in clusters.
preset_rules.feature_shape_tip: How it is drawn; also its height, footprint and default cover.
preset_rules.feature_mass_tip: Mass an engineer gets by reclaiming it.
preset_rules.feature_energy_tip: Energy an engineer gets by reclaiming it.
preset_rules.feature_size_tip: Scale of the model (1 = a pine about 3 units tall, a rock about 1 unit across).
preset_rules.feature_hp_tip: Weapon damage that destroys it (times the map's scale for it). 0 = a default by shape and size.
preset_rules.feature_cover_tip: Share of a shot's damage it soaks up when the shot passes through it. Unticked: by shape (pine 0.3, broadleaf 0.35, bush 0.15, rock 0.65).
preset_rules.feature_weight_tip: How often the map generator picks it among the features of its class.
preset_rules.switches_hint: Turn whole game features on or off. Hover over a name for what it does.
preset_rules.armor_table_hint: Damage a hit does = weapon damage x the number for the target's armor (row) and the weapon's damage type (column). Add or rename armor classes and damage types in the JSON view.
preset_rules.armor_cell_tip: {} damage against {} armor is multiplied by this (1 = full damage, 0 = none).
preset_rules.features_hint: Reclaimable trees and rocks that maps place. Maps refer to them by id.
preset_rules.feature_copy_tip: Add a copy of this type (give it its own id).
preset_rules.feature_remove_tip: Remove this type. Maps that place it can then not be played with this preset.
preset_rules.players_tip: Team colours, in slot order (10 for 10 players).
preset_rules.hostile_tip: Colour of the hostile side's units and buildings.

preset_units.general_id_tip: Unique name the data refers to the unit by (upgrades, commanders, map props). Rename it everywhere if you change it.
preset_units.general_desc_tip: Shown in the build menu tooltip.
preset_units.general_tier_tip: Tech level: a builder of tier N can build units up to tier N. Also the ticks under the strategic icon.
preset_units.general_hp_tip: Damage the unit takes before it is destroyed.
preset_units.general_regen_tip: Hit points it heals by itself every second, up to full health. 0 = none (troopers heal slowly).
preset_units.general_armor_tip: Armor class: decides how much each damage type hurts it (Armor table in rules.json).
preset_units.general_categories_tip: Special roles. infantry: takes cover behind trees, rocks and wrecks and can occupy buildings. armored: what cannons (target priority armored) shoot first. anti_air, artillery, transport: what the unit does (tags for grouping; no effect on the rules yet).
preset_units.general_built_by_tip: Build category: builders and factories that build this category can make it. none = nobody builds it.
preset_units.general_buildable_tip: Off: it never shows in a build menu (map buildings, units that only come from upgrades).
preset_units.general_needs_deposit_tip: Can only be placed on a mass deposit (extractors).
preset_units.general_upgrade_tip: The unit this one turns into when upgraded in place (factories, pumps).
preset_units.general_wreck_tip: Leaves a wreck when destroyed (aircraft never do, and the Wrecks switch in rules.json turns all of them off).
preset_units.general_cargo_tip: Slots it takes in a transport; 0 = cannot be carried.
preset_units.general_assault_tip: Infantry: damage per second in the fight for an occupied building, storming it (ordered into an enemy-held building) or holding it. 0 = cannot storm buildings.
preset_units.general_select_sound_tip: Sound played when it is selected; none = chosen by role.
preset_units.cost_time_tip: Build work: seconds it takes at 1 build power (an engineer with build power 10 needs a tenth of it).
preset_units.body_size_tip: Collision box: units bump into it, and shots hit it unless a hit box is set below. Height also sets where it looks from.
preset_units.body_hit_box_tip: What shots and blasts hit: a box that turns with the unit, standing on its base. Unset = the size.
preset_units.body_footprint_tip: Structures: side length on the build grid (1 cell = 2 units). Mobile units: 0.
preset_units.body_move_kind_tip: none = a structure; land drives, hover floats over water, plane flies.
preset_units.body_move_reverse_tip: Top speed backwards; 0 = it never reverses.
preset_units.body_move_accel_tip: Speed gained or lost per second.
preset_units.body_move_turn_tip: How fast it turns on the spot.
preset_units.body_move_amphibious_tip: Land units: also floats and drives over water of any depth, at full speed.
preset_units.intel_vision_tip: How far it sees (hills, trees and rocks may block it, see the rules switches).
preset_units.intel_spot_time_tip: How long an enemy must have it in view before it is seen, while it keeps still and holds its fire. 0 = at once (tanks, buildings).
preset_units.intel_spot_time_moving_tip: The same while it moves or has just fired. 0 = at once.
preset_units.intel_radar_tip: How far its radar reaches; radar shows contacts but not what they are. This level finds only units without stealth.
preset_units.intel_radar2_tip: How far its level 2 radar reaches: also finds stealth 1 units. A unit is found within the largest range of the levels above its stealth.
preset_units.intel_radar3_tip: How far its level 3 radar reaches: also finds stealth 2 units.
preset_units.intel_stealth_tip: 0 = shows on any radar; 1 = only T2 or T3 radar finds it; 2 = only T3 radar; 3 = never on radar (it has to be seen).
preset_units.eco_upkeep_tip: Energy it uses per second while working (radars, pumps).
preset_units.eco_store_mass_tip: How much mass it adds to its owner's storage.
preset_units.eco_store_energy_tip: How much energy it adds to its owner's storage.
preset_units.build_rate_tip: Build work per second; also the speed of reclaim, repair, capture and terraforming.
preset_units.build_range_tip: How far away it can build, reclaim and repair.
preset_units.build_categories_tip: Build categories it can make (units whose 'Built by' is one of these). None ticked: it only assists, reclaims and repairs.
preset_units.build_tier_tip: It builds units up to this tier.
preset_units.build_station_tip: Immobile builder that assists anything in range on its own.
preset_units.build_scavenger_tip: Cannot build or assist; reclaims wrecks and revives them as its owner's units.
preset_units.binoculars_range_tip: How far it sees inside the cone (hills, trees and rocks still block it).
preset_units.binoculars_angle_tip: Full width of the view cone.
preset_units.binoculars_turn_tip: How fast the binoculars follow a target; scanning goes at half that.
preset_units.binoculars_scan_tip: With nothing to look at it scans this far to either side of where the unit faces; 180 = all round (always so from a building's roof).
preset_units.transport_capacity_tip: Cargo slots it carries. On a structure: a building infantry can occupy and fire from.
preset_units.transport_vision_tip: A building infantry occupy: their vision and binocular range times this (a watch tower). 0 or absent: the rule 'Roof vision'.
preset_units.fieldwork_cover_tip: Share of a shot's damage it takes instead of what it shelters (0 - 1).
preset_units.fieldwork_dig_tip: Above 0 it is a trench: the ground of its cell is dug this deep (and stays so when the trench is destroyed) and it shelters the infantry standing in it from every side. 0: a wall (sandbags) that covers what enemy shots must fly through it to reach.
preset_units.reactive_charges_tip: Missile hits it can take the edge off. Each hit uses one; a full repair replaces them all.
preset_units.reactive_block_tip: Share of a missile hit's damage a charge stops (0 - 1).
preset_units.death_damage_tip: Damage of the explosion when it is destroyed.
preset_units.death_radius_tip: Radius of that explosion. Full damage at the centre, fading to nothing at the edge.
preset_units.icon_shape_tip: Base shape of the strategic icon: land (diamond), bot, air (triangle), structure (square), factory, commander, civilian.
preset_units.icon_glyphs_tip: Symbols on the icon: plus = direct fire, dot = artillery, arc = anti-air, chevron = missile, ring = scout, wave = radar, eng = builder, mass, bolt = energy, store = storage, cargo = transport. Playable units need an icon (with the tier) no other unit has.
preset_units.icon_no_tier_tip: Leave the tier ticks off the icon (storages and the like).
preset_units.icon_model_scale_tip: Size of the 3D model (model files are set in the JSON view).
preset_units.binoculars_tip: A narrow view cone reaching much further than its vision: it scans around, locks onto an enemy it finds (or turns to a known contact in range) and follows it.
preset_units.can_build_tip: Engineers, factories and stations: builds, assists, reclaims, repairs.
preset_units.carries_units_tip: A transport (aircraft, APC) or, on a structure, a building infantry can occupy.
preset_units.field_work_tip: Sandbags or a trench piece: shots fly through it and lose its cover share to it, units cross it, nobody aims at it unless ordered to. Blasts and the shots it stops wear it down.
preset_units.reactive_armor_tip: Explosive tiles that go off when a missile hits (AT troopers, Robins) and stop most of its damage, one hit per charge.
preset_units.explodes_tip: A blast that hurts everything around it.

preset_weapons.name: Name
preset_weapons.name_tip: Shown in the unit's info panel.
preset_weapons.kind_tip: direct: flat shot, needs a clear line of fire and leads its target. arc / high_arc: ballistic, fires over hills. missile: homing. bomb: dropped from a plane.
preset_weapons.damage_type_tip: Decides the armor multiplier (Armor table in rules.json).
preset_weapons.radius_tip: 0 = it only hurts what it hits directly. Otherwise the unit hit takes all the damage and the others around a share of it (Splash), fading to nothing at the edge.
preset_weapons.splash_tip: Share of the damage the blast does to units the shell did not hit directly, at its centre. Unset: the rules' splash for direct-fire guns, all of it for artillery, bombs and missiles.
preset_weapons.range_tip: Furthest target distance. Units must see or radar their target to shoot it.
preset_weapons.min_range_tip: It cannot fire at targets closer than this.
preset_weapons.speed_tip: Shell speed; slow shells are easier to dodge, artillery needs enough of it to reach.
preset_weapons.salvo_tip: Shells fired one after another each time it fires.
preset_weapons.salvo_delay_tip: Seconds between the shells of a salvo.
preset_weapons.aim_time_tip: Seconds the gun must stay on target before it fires.
preset_weapons.hold_tip: Seconds the unit cannot move after each shot; it also fires only while standing still and starts its aim time only then (mortars). 0 = fires on the move.
preset_weapons.ammo_tip: Rounds the weapon carries (every shot of a salvo counts). When they are spent it stops firing until a round is rearmed. 0 = unlimited.
preset_weapons.rearm_tip: Limited ammunition: seconds to rearm one spent round, one at a time (like SupCom tactical missiles). 0 = never rearmed.
preset_weapons.rearm_mass_tip: Limited ammunition: mass one rearmed round costs, paid as a flow over the rearm time (a mass stall slows it).
preset_weapons.targets_tip: What it can shoot at: land (ground units and buildings), air.
preset_weapons.turn_rate_tip: Missiles: how fast they steer toward their target.
preset_weapons.launch_pitch_tip: Missiles: launch elevation (90 = straight up, like a SAM); 0 = a low 20 degrees.
preset_weapons.prefer_tip: Which enemies it shoots first when several are in range: armored (units of category armored: tanks) or infantry. none = the nearest.
preset_weapons.snipe_tip: A hit on a building kills one enemy rider inside instead of damaging the building; it never shoots buildings without enemy riders.
preset_weapons.suicide_tip: Firing launches the unit itself at the target (a homing dive) and removes it, without a wreck or death blast. Give the weapon 1 round of ammunition.
preset_weapons.sound_tip: Shot sound; none = chosen by weapon kind.
preset_weapons.turret_yaw_speed_tip: How fast the turret turns sideways.
preset_weapons.turret_pitch_speed_tip: How fast the barrel moves up and down.
preset_weapons.turret_tip: The gun turns on its own; without a turret the whole unit has to face the target. (Model bones are set in the JSON view.)
preset_weapons.add_weapon_tip: A new cannon with middling numbers; change it to taste.

map_editor.rect_two: Maps that are not square are generated for 2 players (Flat takes any number)
map_editor.lake_tip: Left click: fill the hollow under the pointer with water, as deep at that spot as the slider says. Right click: drain the lake there. Click a lake again after reshaping its shore.
map_editor.scatter_tip: Adds forests and rock fields with the map's symmetry (uses the seed above)
map_editor.flora_brush_hint: Radius and strength above set the brush. Left mouse paints, right mouse removes this kind (trees or rocks).
map_editor.starts_hint: {} start positions. Click the map to place or move one; a new number adds it.
map_editor.no_points_hint: No control points: games on this map place them automatically.
map_editor.points_hint: Left mouse places one, right mouse removes the one under the pointer.
map_editor.auto_place_tip: Replace them with the ones a game would place by itself
map_editor.map_stats: {} cells, {} deposits, {} starts, {} control points, {} objects, {} trees and rocks
map_editor.controls_hint: Left mouse: use tool.  Arrows/WASD pan, wheel zoom.
map_editor.auto_paint_tip: Replaces all layers with the biome's, painted from heights and slopes (also used by Generate and Flat)
map_editor.theme_tip: The look of the map's buildings: wall and roof paints and which house models stand in for the map's houses (shown at High building detail).
map_editor.ground_brush_hint: Radius and strength above set the brush. Left mouse paints the selected layer, right mouse takes it away. On layer 0 it takes away every layer above.
map_editor.road_hint: Left mouse adds a point, right mouse finishes the road (or deletes the road under the pointer). {} roads.
